headline: Identity is your sense of self—the continuous thread of who you are across time and context
universal_truth: You are both constant and changing; identity is the story you tell yourself about who you are
fun_facts: Your identity isn't fixed at birth—it develops and evolves throughout life
People have multiple identities that activate in different contexts
The brain actively constructs a coherent sense of self from fragmented experiences
discussion_questions: How would you describe who you are in a few sentences?
What stays constant about you and what has changed?
How much of your identity did you choose versus inherit?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Who are you? Not your name or job—who are you really? The question seems simple but isn't. Identity is the story you tell yourself about yourself—the thread connecting who you were, are, and will be.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Identity feels solid but is actually fluid. What is this 'self' that seems so stable yet keeps changing?

options.text: Identity is a constructed narrative—the ongoing story you tell about who you are, integrating experiences into a coherent self; it's real but not fixed
options.response: Yes. Your brain creates a story that connects experiences into a continuous 'you.' This narrative is real and shapes behavior, but it's also editable. You're the author.

options.text: Identity is just who you are naturally
options.response: There are natural elements, but identity is also shaped by experience, choice, and context...

q1.title: Inherited and Chosen
q1.script: Some identity is inherited: genetics, culture, early experiences. Some is chosen: values, commitments, self-development. Knowing which is which gives you freedom to keep or change.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Inherited and Chosen"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Multiple Selves
q2.script: You have multiple identities—professional self, family self, friend self. These aren't fake; they're facets. Identity is plural, adapting to context while maintaining core continuity.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Narrative Power
q3.script: The story you tell about yourself becomes self-fulfilling. 'I'm bad at math' becomes true through avoidance. 'I'm learning' opens possibility. You author your identity narrative.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You are both constant and changing. Identity is the story you tell yourself about who you are. Author it deliberately.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 323. Tomorrow, we'll explore showing who you are—self-expression. Until then, consider the story you tell about yourself.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Identity Story - Who Do You Say You Are?
growTrack.learning_objective: Examine and consciously shape identity narrative
growTrack.activity: Write your identity story: Who are you? What are your core values? What has stayed constant through your life? What would you like to change? You're the author—what story do you want to tell?
